description: This file provides functions related to theming for a dashboard, including defining a base theme ('Ocean Professional'), generating a categorical color palette seeded with theme colors, and mapping categories to colors. It exports functions that supply theme tokens, generate color palettes, and create category-to-color mappings.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens, including colors, typography, radii, and elevation.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette based on the Ocean theme colors, suitable for categorical series, ensuring contrast and distinction for up to N categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps category labels to colors from the categorical palette, maintaining a stable order.
